fsharp.adoption_scope: api, workers, orchestration, jobs, campaigns, programs, portfolio, and storage adapters

julia.adoption_scope: future scientific cross-checks and probabilistic alternatives, not the primary rewrite shell

python.adoption_scope: frozen contract source of truth until F# reaches parity

rust.adoption_scope: systems burden and K8s/HPC edge comparison, not the chosen primary rewrite

sounio.adoption_scope: scientific semantics, kernels, manifests, and runtime contracts

stan.adoption_scope: calibration, uncertainty estimation, posterior checks, and comparative evidence

subsystems.name: scientific_kernel
subsystems.why: Kernel semantics, manifest execution, provenance, and benchmark-backed scientific claims belong to Sounio.

subsystems.name: control_plane
subsystems.why: Typed orchestration, units-of-measure, ASP.NET Core integration, and lower glue burden than Python.

subsystems.name: probabilistic_baseline
subsystems.why: Calibration and uncertainty should be benchmarked against a mature probabilistic baseline, not embedded in the workflow shell.

subsystems.name: k8s_hpc_edge
subsystems.why: The primary rewrite stays F#-first, but K8s and systems burden stay explicitly comparable against Rust.

thesis: Sounio plus F# is the target rewrite stack; Stan is the probabilistic baseline lane.
